description: Retires a pay link that has NOT been paid (give code = the pcl_… part of pay_url, or site_key), so nobody can pay it. Nothing is charged. A link that was already paid cannot be cancelled here.

code.description: The link code: the pcl_… part at the end of pay_url.

site_key.description: Or the site whose open pay link to cancel.

name: cancel_client_checkout
title: Cancel an unused pay link
